edges: DuQuesne plans to build his own spaceship.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Marc 'Blackie' DuQuesne conspires to sabotage Dick Seaton's spaceship.
Seaton obtains a promise from DuQuesne to act as part of the group until they return to Earth.
Seaton is married to Dorothy Vaneman.
Marc 'Blackie' DuQuesne builds his own spaceship from Seaton's plans.
